title: Peak Sensor Analytics
description: An industrial IoT system streams integer readings from a temperature sensor. You are asked to analyze the peak reading within every contiguous window of length k as the window moves from left to right across the stream. Return an array containing the maximum value for each window position.
input_format: An array of integers temperatures and an integer k representing the sliding window size.
output_format: An array of integers representing the maximum value in each window.

examples.explanation: Window position [1 3 -1] max is 3. [3 -1 -3] max is 3. [-1 -3 5] max is 5. [-3 5 3] max is 5. [5 3 6] max is 6. [3 6 7] max is 7.
There is only one element, so the maximum is 1.
The only window is [9, 11] which has a maximum of 11.
